description: Raccess Exact rerun at K=4 (access_len=1,3,7,10), matching the K=4 used for LinearRaccess and Raccess Window in benchmark/results/bprna_matched_runtime, so all three methods in Fig. 3 use the same K. max_span is set to each sequence's own length (unrestricted), which is what makes this 'Exact' rather than a K setting; only run up to 1,000 nt as in the original raccess_exact bundle, since Raccess Exact's O(N^3) cost makes longer sequences impractical.
